[=Repository Overview=]

[.txt|SPO_CS/SPO_CS.csproj.] is the implementation core and the executable test host.
Compiler, runtime, modules, and most verification ship from this one project.

[=Project Build Facts=]

[| [*Property*] | [*Current value*] |]
[| TargetFramework | [.txt|net10.0.] |]
[| LangVersion | [.txt|14.0.] |]
[| OutputType | [.txt|Exe.] |]
[| PublishAot | [.txt|true.] |]
[| Test source convention | [.txt|**\*.Tests.cs.] via [.txt|TestSrc.] |]

[=Working Tree Shape=]

[| [*Path*] | [*Role in the working tree*] |]
[| [.txt|SPO_CS/.] | implementation center: compiler pipeline, VM, modules, and test host |]
[| [.txt|SPO/.] | sample host executable for standalone `.spo` files |]

[=Implementation Layers=]

[| [*Layer*] | [*Primary files*] | [*Responsibility*] |]
[| Common infrastructure | [.txt|SPO_CS/src/Common/.] | containers, parser helpers, FS, test DSL, and shared utilities |]
[| Frontends | [.txt|mTokenizer.], [.txt|mSPO_Parser.], [.txt|mIL_Parser.] | read SPO and IL text |]
[| SPO semantics | [.txt|mSPO_AST.], [.txt|mSPO_Desugar.], [.txt|mSPO_AST_Types.] | AST shape, sugar removal, type analysis, and scope building |]
[| Backend boundary | [.txt|mIL_AST.], [.txt|mSPO2IL.] | shared IL module model and lowering target |]
[| Backend execution | [.txt|mIL_GenerateOpcodes.], [.txt|mVM_Data.], [.txt|mVM.] | opcode generation and runtime execution |]
[| Modules and tests | [.txt|mModule.], [.txt|mRunTests.], [.txt|mRegression_Tests.], [.txt|mModule_Tests.] | real artifacts, dependency wiring, and verification |]

[=Operational Anchors=]

- [.txt|mRunTests.cs.] is the practical CLI entry point for verification work
- [.txt|mModule.cs.] is the registry and loader for the built-in module surface
- current test counts, red paths, and launch-directory caveats belong in [<../40_verification/41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki|41_tests_and_artifacts.wiki>], not on this overview page

[=Primary Entry Points=]

- [.txt|mRunTests.cs.]
  CLI test host and filter behavior
- [.txt|mSPO_Interpreter.Run(...).]
  end-to-end entry for SPO source text
- [.txt|mVM.Run(mIL_AST.tModule, ...).]
  direct entry for parsed IL modules
- [.txt|mModule.Init(...).]
  file-based module loading and `.SPO` versus `.ILT` checking
- [<../../SPO/src/Program.cs|SPO/src/Program.cs>]
  sample host embedding with [.txt|_StdLib.] and [.txt|_LoadModule....]
- [<../../index.html|index.html>]
  browser entry point for repo-local wiki and source viewing

[=Architectural Contracts=]

- [.txt|mTokenizer.] is intentionally shared by the SPO and IL parsers
- [.txt|mIL_AST.tModule.] is the hard boundary between frontends and backend execution
- [.txt|mVM_Type.] participates across parsing, type analysis, lowering, opcode generation, and runtime
- `.SPO` modules are lowered internally to an init lambda of the form [.txt|ImportPattern => { Commands; RETURN Export }.]
- [.txt|SPO_CS/Modules/.] and [.txt|SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.] are executable artifacts, not decorative samples
